title: Allah Loves You: Beginning with Mercy
summary: The first thing that settles in a child's heart about his Lord stays with him for a long time, so it should begin with love, not fear. Tell your child «Allah loves you» when he is happy and when he errs too, and do not use Allah's name to threaten or to manage behaviour — «if you do not listen, Allah will be upset with you» creates an early fear that is hard to undo years later. Obedience is built with clear limits and tenderness; belief is built with love. Neither one is borrowed for the other.
try_this: This week: notice one single sentence in which you linked Allah's name to punishment or anger, and replace it. Once is enough to show you how often it recurs.
reflection_prompts: When was the last time Allah's name came up in your home during a reprimand?
In what words do you tell your child he is loved even after a mistake?
